answers.core: such an editor script would be more resource intensive and less intuitive. However, that assessment comes a priori of having written any plugins.
answers.workaround: and editor script could likely be written to convert materials from spatial to shader, and inject/remove the code for the effect, but it would have to access editor features, as at the time this material feature was developed there was no way I had found to convert materials using gdscript.
